name: Hololens 1.3.8 diagnostic preview - visible version information
body:
Hololens 1.3.8 diagnostic preview / build38

Adds the installed version/code to ChatGPT settings and connection progress. Retains the confirmed Android ICU move-validation fix from 1.3.7 and the single reconnect control for a saved disconnected account.

This is NOT a proven fix for the phone invalid-package installation failure and NOT a claim of successful phone inference. Actual Android installation, live ChatGPT login/inference, physical camera and dual-device PvP remain unverified. The existing phone-file checksum is still useful; do not repeatedly download, uninstall or clear app data.

Original package/signing identity, exact home layout and character size, artwork, saved-data code, card/translation update channel and existing engine are preserved. The 1.4.0 engine candidate is not included.

Verification: 345/352 host tests passed; seven unchanged Windows directory-sync failures remain documented, so the host suite is not all-green. ChatGPT 120/120, home viewport 7/7 and offline AI 10/10 passed. Native ICU checks cover 104 patterns across 85 main Java files. Lint: 0 errors/40 warnings. Official signature, manifest/resource parsing, ZIP alignment/CRC and DEX checksum checks passed. Android instrumentation compiled but was not run. Four unchanged native libraries retain a separate 16 KiB RELRO runtime-validation caveat.

No live OAuth, subscription inference, new credentials or device installation was performed during verification.

Installation: use HoloLens.apk, or extract Hololens-1.3.8-Install.zip and then open its APK. Do not install or rename the ZIP itself. This is intended as an in-place update using the original signer; preserve your existing app/data. Stable 1.2.8 and all previous releases remain available.
